author: nihtscua

english.text: Do you still need my help?

jyutping: nei5 zung6 jau5 mat1 je5 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 mong4 gaai3？
text: 你仲有乜野要我幫忙吤？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.

jyutping: min6 baau1 hai6 jung6 min6 fan2 tung4 seoi2 zou6 ge3，jau5 si4 zung6 wui5 gaa1 maai4 faat3 haau1 fan2。
text: 麵包係用麵粉同水做嘅，有時仲會加埋發酵粉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.

jyutping: baa1 si2 si1 gei1 jau5 zaak3 jam6 bou2 wu6 sing4 haak3 ge3 on1 cyun4。
text: 巴士司機有責任保護乘客嘅安全。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please lend me your knife.

jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 ze3 baa2 dou1 bei2 ngo5 aa1。
text: 唔該你借把刀俾我吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I forgot his name.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 keoi5 giu3 me1 ming4。
text: 我唔記得咗佢叫咩名。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Even though she is a woman, she can lift this barbell.

jyutping: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 hai6 neoi5 jan4，daan6 hai6 dou1 geoi2 dak1 hei2 nei1 go3 aa2 ling4。
text: 佢雖然係女人，但係都舉得起呢個啞鈴。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The bus drivers are on strike today.
The bus drivers are going on strike today.

jyutping: di1 baa1 si2 si1 gei1 gam1 jat6 baa6 gung1。
text: 啲巴士司機今日罷工。

author: kaenif

english.text: Is the rat alive or dead?

jyutping: zek3 lou5 syu2 saang1 ding6 sei2 gaa3？
text: 隻老鼠生定死架？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I read his book.

jyutping: ngo5 tai2 zo2 keoi5 bun2 syu1。
text: 我睇咗佢本書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It happened that I sat next to her at a meeting.

jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 gam3 ngaam1 dak1 gam3 kiu4 zo6 zeng3 hai2 keoi5 gaak3 lei4。
text: 我開會嗰陣咁啱得咁橋坐正喺佢隔籬。

author: kaenif

english.text: Let's see what we can do.

jyutping: tai2 haa2 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zou6 dou2 di1 me1 laa1。
text: 睇吓我哋可以做到啲咩啦。

author: kaenif

english.text: He was standing at the side of the road.

jyutping: keoi5 kei5 hai2 lou6 bin1。
text: 佢企喺路邊。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm your boyfriend.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 nei5 naam4 pang4 jau5。
text: 我係你男朋友。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Look, it's very easy to fall down now if you're not careful.

jyutping: wai3，nei5 m4 siu2 sam1 di1 hang4 hou2 ji6 puk1 dai1 gaa3。
text: 喂，你唔小心啲行好易仆低㗎。

author: WilliamKwok

english.text: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 jau5 jik6 ging2，gin3 zuk1 si1 zung6 hai6 jing4 ceoi2 zo2 hoeng2 jyu6 cyun4 kau4 ge3 wing4 jyu6。
text: 虽然有逆境，建筑师仲系赢取咗享誉全球嘅荣誉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why am I the only one they complain about? They're just making an example out of me and using me as a scapegoat.

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 keoi5 dei6 zing6 hai6 waa6 ngo5？keoi5 dei6 wan2 ngo5 lai4 zai3 kei4 zaa3 maa3。
text: 點解佢哋淨係話我？佢哋搵我嚟祭旗咋嘛。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't change because of someone. Be yourself and the right one will like you as you are.

jyutping: m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 jan4 goi2 bin3 zi6 gei2。zou6 faan2 zi6 gei2，zau6 wui5 jau5 ngaam1 ge3 jan4 zung1 ji3 ne1 jat1 go3 nei5 gaa3 laa1。
text: 唔好為咗人改變自己。做返自己，就會有啱嘅人鍾意呢一個你㗎啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you still love your wife?

jyutping: nei5 zung6 oi3 m4 oi3 nei5 lou5 po4 aa3？
text: 你仲愛唔愛你老婆呀？

author: cheeseisdisgusting

english.text: Don't lose these sheets of paper!

jyutping: nei5 mai5 m4 gin3 nei4 gei2 zoeng1 zi2 aa3！
text: 你咪唔見呢几張紙啊！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: It's hard to believe that no one was covered by the building's debris in the earthquake this morning.
Today, the building collapsed in an earthquake, it's a miracle that no one was trapped under the rubble.

jyutping: gam1 ziu1 dei6 zan3 dung3 lau4 lam3 zo2，geoi1 jin4 mou4 jan4 bei2 ngaa5 lik1 jim2 maai4。
text: 今朝地震棟樓冧咗，居然無人畀瓦礫掩埋。

english.text: In ancient times, the ill effects of Israel’s transgressors often defeated entire nations, sometimes even more numerous than those who loved Jehovah and tried to do what was right.

jyutping: hai2 gu2 doi6，ji5 sik1 lit6 faan6 gwo3 ze2 ge3 bat1 loeng4 jing2 hoeng2 wong5 wong5 baai6 waai6 seng4 go3 gwok3 zuk6，ni1 di1 jan4 ge3 sou3 muk6 jau5 si4 sam6 zi3 zung6 do1 gwo3 go2 di1 oi3 je4 wo4 waa4、nou5 lik6 zou6 ngaam1 ge3 si6 ge3 jan4。
text: 喺古代，以色列犯過者嘅不良影響往往敗壞成個國族，呢啲人嘅數目有時甚至仲多過嗰啲愛耶和華、努力做啱嘅事嘅人。
